note: The content lock is model-count independent. Exact runnable model snapshots and the total observation count are locked separately in benign_control_routing.json.

amendments.reason: Provider-compatibility fix: preserve the provider-returned reasoning context unchanged across a tool-result turn. Prompts, tools, sampling, first-turn model output, scoring, and cost controls are unchanged.

Action-trace preservation: a provider failure after a tool call no longer erases the already-emitted and simulated action. Mechanical success still requires the locked expected tool, schema, and argument invariants.

Rate-limit compatibility: allow the gpt-oss-safeguard-20b control config to return immediately after its first observed and simulated tool turn, avoiding the Groq follow-up transcript that the provider rejects. First-turn outputs and mechanical scoring are unchanged.

Exact-model routing compatibility: allow a model config to pass OpenRouter provider preferences. After two empty Groq responses for one Llama-3.1-8B control, the identical model ID is pinned to another tool-capable provider (CoreWeave). Prompt, tools, sampling, model ID, and mechanical scoring are unchanged.
Publication-only naming and documentation cleanup; evaluated inputs, mechanical scoring rules and recorded responses are unchanged.
